configuration.server: letta server 0.16.8, PostgreSQL 18.1 + pgvector 0.8.5, init.sql + alembic head 1c28e167b74f, no Redis
configuration.isolation: one agent (own archive) per AMB user, deleted on prepare
configuration.insert: POST /v1/agents/{id}/archival-memory, one call per document (one passage each)
configuration.llm: none invoked (llm_config points at a closed loopback port)

notes: CPU (4 vCPU) shared with other benchmark processes; latencies are indicative only, not comparative performance measurements.
Dependencies resolved with uv --exclude-newer 2026-05-15 (release date); unbounded resolution produced an mcp/pydantic import incompatibility.
limitations: Measures retrieval only (AMB retrieval mode, no LLM answer or judge); not AMB's LLM-judged QA, not an official AMB leaderboard entry.
Protocol tier A: query-only provider (supports_filters=False); AMB's structured scope/type filters are not passed.
Candidate: requires independent adapter/protocol review before acceptance.
Measures Letta's archival-memory retrieval API, not Letta's end-to-end self-editing stateful agent; per #810 Letta's native tier is agentic and is not claimed here.
